prompt_recommendations.title: Enforce mandatory opening turn with pose_question
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The system was told explicitly to greet and pose the first warm-up question, but the transcript shows no tutor output, indicating the opening protocol failed.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: Begin the lesson. Greet the student briefly, name what they'll learn in one short sentence, then immediately pose the first warm-up question via pose_question
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add to system prompt: 'Your FIRST message MUST contain: (1) a one-line greeting, (2) a one-sentence lesson objective, (3) a call to pose_question with the full question stem and options visible in the reply. Never respond with an empty or tool-only message on turn 1.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Guarantees a visible opening question, preventing dead-start sessions.

prompt_recommendations.title: Require visible text alongside every tool call
prompt_recommendations.rationale: Repeated silent/empty replies suggest tool calls without visible text; student had to prompt 'try asking your question again'.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: No worries! It seems like we had a little hiccup. Could you please try asking your question again?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'Every assistant turn MUST include non-empty visible text for the student, even when invoking tools. Tool-only turns are forbidden.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevents blank turns and improves recovery from tool failures.

prompt_recommendations.title: Add a fallback for tool failure
prompt_recommendations.rationale: When pose_question fails, the tutor should still present the question inline as plain text.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: It seems like we had a little hiccup.
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Add: 'If a tool call fails or returns no output, immediately present the question stem (and options) as plain text in the visible reply and continue the lesson.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Session continues even under tool errors.

flow_recommendations.title: Detect and retry empty tutor turns
flow_recommendations.rationale: Engine allowed two consecutive empty tutor turns; a watchdog should force a retry with a plain-text fallback.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: Could you please try asking your question again?
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevents user-visible dead sessions caused by tool errors.

flow_recommendations.title: Log and alert on pose_question failures
flow_recommendations.rationale: Silent failure of the primary question-posing tool halted the lesson entirely.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: It seems like we had a little hiccup.
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Enables engineering to diagnose and fix tool integration issues.

experience_recommendations.title: Provide a friendly recovery message when the tutor stalls
experience_recommendations.rationale: Student had to prompt the tutor to try again, which is a poor experience.
experience_recommendations.evidence_quote: No worries! It seems like we had a little hiccup.

overall_summary: The session never actually started: no tutor turns appear in the transcript. The student had to prompt the tutor to retry after an apparent tool failure. All pedagogical principles score 0 by default because no teaching occurred. Fixes should ensure the opening turn always contains visible text with the first question, and that tool failures fall back to plain-text delivery.
